items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Jack Hylton, the greatest of the English bands at the time, hadn't reached his peak.

ctx.x: Let's go back to England. And the Holburn Empire in London, for instance. Did you find any difference in the English people? Because at that time there were English jazz people. There were people who were playing some jazz, trying to imitate --
Well, yes, I found a difference, because at those days, Jack Hylton, the greatest of the English bands at the time, hadn't reached his peak.
